name: Joe Goldberg

skins.name: Henderson
skins.lore: The Henderson skin references Joe Goldberg wearing a mask with Henderson's face while confronting him and trying to force a confession.

skins.name: Billionaire
skins.lore: The Billionaire skin represents Joe Goldberg during Season 5 while living a luxurious billionaire lifestyle alongside Kate Lockwood.

skins.name: Eat the rich
skins.lore: The Eat the rich skin references Joe Goldberg during Season 4 when he becomes trapped inside a basement that is later set on fire by his Rhys Montrose alter ego.

skins.name: Love
skins.lore: The Love skin references Love Quinn from YOU, Joe Goldberg's wife and one of the most dangerous killers in the series.

skins.name: Paris
skins.lore: The Paris skin represents Joe Goldberg at the end of Season 3 after traveling to Paris in search of Marienne.

skins.name: Intruding
skins.lore: The Intruding skin references Joe Goldberg infiltrating the mansion of the Lockwood twins while attempting to kidnap Reagan.

skins.name: Intensity
skins.lore: The Intensity skin references the near finale of Season 5 when Louise threatens Joe Goldberg with a gun to force a confession, leading Joe to begin violently chasing her.

skins.name: Consequences
skins.lore: The Consequences skin represents Joe Goldberg after finally being imprisoned at the end of the story and forced to face the consequences of his crimes.

lore: Joe Goldberg is the main protagonist of the psychological thriller series YOU. Intelligent, manipulative, and dangerously obsessive, Joe hides his violent tendencies behind a calm and charming personality while convincing himself that every crime he commits is justified by love.
